[Changing distance in the parametrix] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0289 1. ch24:24.3\group Local Parametrix

Although $\partial _\tau (r_\tau ^2)$ is not usually explicit, only its local expansion near $y$ is needed in the parametrix construction.
